name: Funding Activity
blurb: Capital flowing into AI, by stage and sector.

reading.body:
AI funding filings tracked here rose from 119 to 122 across the three weeks ending September 2, 2026, a small but steady increase spread across 47 companies.

The filing count moved in discrete steps rather than smoothly, holding at 119 from August 14 through 17, stepping to 121 by August 21, and reaching 122 by August 28, where it has held since. That stair-step pattern suggests filings are logged in batches rather than continuously, which matters for reading the series as a trend rather than a live feed.

This data counts filings, not dollar amounts, valuations, or round stages, so it cannot support a claim about how much capital is moving into AI, only that the number of tracked funding filings is still climbing. With no by-month or recent-deals breakdown populated in this entry, there is nothing here to say which companies or sectors are driving the increase.
